title: Decomposition by point indicators
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $f$ from the finite subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb{R}$, $f$ is the sum, over all such subsets $A$, of $f(A)$ times the point indicator of $A$.
